Hi Lena — thanks, Jonas. Below is the concise evidence package and notes mapped to the CAIQ/CSA control intents relevant to telemetry and key custody. I've uploaded the artifacts to the shared Drive link Jonas referenced and listed the attachment stubs.

Summary of retention tiers (applies to Redwood-hosted and Private deployments unless customer overrides documented in an SLA):
- Debug/Verbose logs: ephemeral ingest buffers retained 0–7 days (default 3 days) before trimming/aggregation to reduce PII risk.
- Trace / request-level telemetry (per-request traces, latency metadata): retained 30 days in operational index, 365 days in compressed archive for compliance/forensics if an audit is opened.
- Metrics/aggregates (prometheus-style counters, derived metrics): retained 540 days for trend analysis and SLO calculation.
- KV cache access logs (prefix hits/misses without full payload): retained 90 days.

Key custody options (Private deployments):
- Customer-managed KMS: recommended for regulated workloads. Keys live in the customer's cloud KMS/HSM (we support AWS KMS, GCP KMS with External Key Manager, Azure Key Vault HSM). Evidence: keystore-rotation.pdf (rotation schedule + signer), KMS-configuration-snippet.txt (redacted). Maps to CAIQ controls: CCS-KEY-01 (key lifecycle), CCS-KEY-02 (HSM usage attestation).
- Redwood-managed HSM (optional): hosted HSM with audited rotation, documented access controls and split knowledge. Evidence: keystore-rotation.pdf (Redwood HSM attestation) and audit summary.

Sanitization & telemetry sampling notes:
- Runtime-log-sample.json is sanitized to remove tenant identifiers and any sensitive tokens; we keep timestamp granularity at milliseconds and include an obfuscated request_id and truncated stack frames.
- Logs use ISO8601 timestamps and a monotonic offset for sequence validation (helps auditors verify retention / log continuity).

Attachments uploaded (Drive):
- keystore-rotation.pdf (KMS/HSM rotation schedules, last rotation events, signer list) [attachment stub]
- telemetry-retention-matrix.xlsx (matrix with control mappings and retention windows) [attachment stub]
- enclave-architecture-diagram.png (diagram showing private deployment enclave and KMS boundary) [attachment stub]
- runtime-log-sample.json (sanitized sample runtime trace, 2KB) [attachment stub]

Quick mapping to CAIQ/CSA intents (non-exhaustive):
- LOG-01 (retention & integrity): telemetry-retention-matrix.xlsx demonstrates retention policies and audit hooks.
- LOG-03 (redaction & minimization): runtime-log-sample.json demonstrates tenant redaction and minimal retention of PII.
- KMS-02 (key custody): keystore-rotation.pdf shows rotation cadence and customer vs Redwood custody options.

Next steps: Marissa will share a short export with the Drive link and a checklist for artifacts you should expect to see in the ZIP. If you require a formal signed attestation, Jonas — please advise and we'll route the DocuSign.

Thanks,

Hi Lena — quick answers to your two questions:

1) The runtime-log-sample includes both the original event timestamp (event_ts) and the ingestion timestamp (ingest_ts). We include a monotonic sequence id in each log line so your team can validate ordering and detect ingestion gaps. The sample in runtime-log-sample.json shows event_ts: "2027-04-28T14:03:21.123Z" and ingest_ts: "2027-04-28T14:03:21.543Z" — that pattern is consistent across our runtime pipeline.

2) For customer-managed KMS we emit control-plane key-usage metadata to a restricted audit index managed by Redwood (retained for 90 days) — this metadata contains key_id, operation (Encrypt/Decrypt/Sign), and timestamp; it does not include raw materialized keys. Customers can choose to mirror those logs into their own SIEM via our forwarding connector or we can provide redacted export for audits. Evidence: keystore-rotation.pdf includes an example key-usage extract and the telemetry-retention-matrix.xlsx documents the 90-day retention for these metadata entries.

Drive upload: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-aurelia-caiq-evidence (files should be visible now).

DocuSign attestation: if you confirm you need a signed custody attestation we can turn it around within 3 business days — Jonas, please confirm if Aurelia requests signature.

Closing note: happy to jump on a 30-minute call if the reviewers want a short walkthrough of the artifacts.
